steps.en: Install the APK and add a model key or account sign-in
steps.zh: 装好 APK，填模型 key 或用账号登录

steps.en: Turn on debugging switches and type the pairing code once
steps.zh: 打开调试开关，输入一次配对码

steps.en: Pair with wireless debugging and start its shell-level helper
steps.zh: 与无线调试配对，拉起 shell 身份的助手

steps.en: Say or type a task in the chat
steps.zh: 在对话里说或打一句任务

steps.en: Open the apps on a hidden screen, read the UI and tap through
steps.zh: 在隐藏的虚拟屏上开 App、读界面、逐步点按

steps.en: Ask when the spending heuristic flags a step; hand logins back and report results
steps.zh: 规则识别花钱步骤才询问；登录交给你，再回报结果

value.en: Errands across API-less apps done from one sentence while you keep using the phone
value.zh: 一句话办完没有 API 的 App 里的事，手机照常可用
